ACCEPT — PR #13211 @ `936268b42c4c9d304423efac71ee14e1898fbf67` · `domain:ui` seat 2 (`session_01XVp19E1MYUTFM3dnkwz8gB`)

- Clause-②: no. The type-grid markup is internal to `CreateViewDialog.tsx`; no export, prop or i18n row moves. No contract review is owed, and the seat read the report.
- Seat review: a blocked type card now shows its specific reason as visible text, either the existing `viewTypeUnavailable` sentence with the field interpolated or `viewTypeUnavailableDataset`. The short "Not supported by this object." is no longer rendered, and the redundant `title` is gone. Each card's label is its `aria-labelledby` and its text line is its `aria-describedby`, so a screen reader reads the reason. Disabled cards stay disabled and unfocusable (ruling 2). The description clamp is dropped, and the grid goes from 4 columns to `grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3` with the dialog width unchanged (ruling 3). Selection, the type set and availability are unchanged.
- Pins: (a) the field reason and (b) the dataset reason are each visible and are the accessible description. (c) A selectable description is full and unclamped. (d) CONTROL: selection is unchanged. The ablation turned (a)–(c) red and the existing dataset case red, with (d) green, and the restore was proven by blob. The six `CreateViewDialog.*` files (126) and the ObjectView create flows are green. The existing `chartBinding-11576` dataset case was updated to the ruled output.
- Changeset: `@object-ui/app-shell` `patch`.
- CI: all 36 check-runs completed on the head, 33 passed and 3 skipped.
- Path fork: no governed path. Seat landing.
- Findings: Acceptance notes. (1) `console.objectView.viewTypeUnavailableShort` now has no call site, so its rows are dead in every locale. Retiring them is a one-key cleanup the next i18n pass can carry. (2) A disabled card keeps `opacity-50`, which also dims the newly visible reason. It stays legible and is the existing disabled treatment, so it is not filed. The browser visual check was not measured.

Next: ready + auto-merge; landing is verified by content on `main`.
